projects.title: CallDojo
projects.description: Voice role-play trainer for loan agents: talk to, and interrupt, an AI borrower in English, Hinglish or Tanglish, then get a scorecard. About 1.5 s to first audio; the scorer caught 7/7 misquoted rates and fees.

projects.title: ARIA Agent
projects.description: Autonomous Risk Intelligence Agent: fuses financial-filing anomaly scoring with 30-day news risk into a 0–100 composite score. A hallucination guard drops any figure not in the filing; live SSE progress and PDF audit reports.

projects.title: Explainable AI Research
projects.description: Post-hoc XAI framework (SHAP, LIME) for clinical risk models on UCI Heart Disease: Random Forest reached 83.61% accuracy and 96.97% recall; feature rankings held 0.94 Spearman correlation under σ = 0.20 noise.

projects.title: FinPilot
projects.description: PENTATHON 3.0 winner. Real-time transaction streaming, receipt parsing with line-item extraction and price-anomaly detection, PDF reports; sub-120 ms live UI updates.

projects.title: Trust Flow
projects.description: Customs compliance agent built by a team of 3 (I owned the pipeline and backend): a 13-node LangGraph pipeline with human-in-the-loop review, bounding-box document provenance, a US/UAE YAML rule engine and live USITC HTS classification.

projects.title: Pluse
projects.description: Distributed job platform featuring atomic job claiming (SKIP LOCKED + advisory locks + lock-token fencing), DLQ with idempotent replay, and Groq-powered failure telemetry.

projects.title: PackAssist Demo
projects.description: Interactive showcase of 3D bin-packing and spatial layout engine for automotive trunk optimization. Features client-side greedy packing and live 3D orbital inspection.

projects.title: FlappyMind
projects.description: Deep RL agent trained with PPO on flappy-bird-gymnasium using a 180-ray LIDAR observation space. Deployed in-browser via Pygbag/Wasm with a high score of 451 pipes.

projects.title: Image Captioning
projects.description: Frozen CLIP ViT-B/16 backbone with a Transformer head and 6-layer decoder, trained on MS COCO with cross-entropy then SCST: BLEU-4 40.7 and CIDEr 135.4 on the 5,000-image Karpathy test split, with per-word attention heatmaps.

projects.title: Translator App
projects.description: Text and image translation across 40 languages using the DeepL API, with in-browser Tesseract.js OCR for photos and browser text-to-speech output.

projects.title: PulseOps
projects.description: Microservices observability platform: 6 FastAPI services in an order saga with OpenTelemetry tracing, Prometheus/Grafana/Loki/Jaeger, and a chaos console that kills pods and measures recovery. CI deploys to a kind cluster and verifies self-healing on every push.

projects.title: EchoCrypt
projects.description: End-to-end encrypted chat where the server only stores ciphertext: ECDH + AES-256-GCM per-message keys, ECDSA-signed messages, zero-knowledge accounts and WebAuthn passkeys. Two API instances behind nginx with Redis Pub/Sub; p50 delivery ≈ 9 ms.

projects.title: SnapURL
projects.description: URL shortener with exactly-once click analytics over Redis Streams (consumer groups + XAUTOCLAIM crash recovery) and privacy-preserving unique-visitor counts. k6: ~2,080 req/s redirects, p99 34.6 ms, 0 failures. Self-hosted on Oracle Cloud.

projects.title: CodeSynq
projects.description: Real-time collaborative code editor with a hand-written Operational Transformation engine (compose, transform, 3-state client), cursor presence, multi-file rooms and in-room code execution in 30+ languages. OT fuzz-tested for convergence.

projects.title: ResuMatch
projects.description: Resume vs job-description gap analyzer: splits a posting into weighted requirements and matches each to its best resume line with MiniLM embeddings, so every score comes with evidence. No LLM; 45-pair labelled eval against 3 baselines.

projects.title: Self-Pruning Neural Network
projects.description: Learnable sigmoid-gate pruning layer with an L1 gate penalty, trained on CIFAR-10; ~56% test accuracy across three sparsity penalties.

projects.title: translator.nlp
projects.description: English→Hindi neural machine translation: GRU Seq2Seq with Bahdanau attention, trained on ~118K IITB sentence pairs, with D3.js attention heatmaps.

projects.title: Scholarship & Financial Aid Portal
projects.description: DBMS course project (team of 2, project lead): admin and student roles, eligibility checks, document upload and finance reporting.

projects.title: BroLift
projects.description: College carpooling app: ride search, seat requests, fare split, live fuel-price scraping and ride chat. Built solo in 2-week sprints.

projects.title: PulseAPI
projects.description: Notification priority queue on a custom MinHeap and a knapsack-based vehicle maintenance scheduler, with a shared logging middleware package.
